name: Fire Bolt
blurb: Cantrip. Hits one spot and lights anything flammable there.

name: Ray of Frost
blurb: Cantrip. A 25 ft beam from you toward where you click. Freezes water into walkable ice and snuffs fire. RAW it only chills a creature; the ice is our physical reading.

name: Shocking Grasp
blurb: Cantrip. Lightning travels through water and metal that touch the spot.

name: Gust of Wind
blurb: A 60 ft line of wind from you toward where you click. Pushes light things, blows out small flames, fans big ones, drives windmills.

name: Grease
blurb: A slick 10 ft square. Things slide across it. Flammable here, as in BG3; check the SRD text before relying on that.

name: Create Water
blurb: Pours water that flows downhill, fills pits and boilers, douses fire, and soaks creatures.

name: Thunderwave
blurb: A wave of force all around you. Throws everything next to you away from you, even a boulder, a little.

name: Misty Step
blurb: Blink up to 30 ft to a square you can see. Bars and gates don't block sight; walls do.

name: Levitate
blurb: One thing floats for a while, you included. It ignores pits and slick ground, and the lightest gust carries it.

name: Mage Hand
blurb: Pick up something light (tap it), then set it down within 30 ft (tap the spot).

name: Mold Earth
blurb: Cantrip. Excavates a 10 ft patch one step down, stripping grass and anything spilled on it. Water runs in.

name: Mold Earth (heap)
blurb: Cantrip. Heaps a 10 ft patch one step up. Water on it spills off; a low bank turns a trickle.

name: Earthen Trench
blurb: Gouges a 40 ft channel two steps deep from your feet toward where you click. Cut it from a pond and the water follows. Our reading of earth shaping; not an SRD spell.

name: Wall of Stone
blurb: A 30 ft wall of rock rises from where you click, running away from you, wall-high even across a trench. Blocks walking, sight, gas and water; dams a stream. Dig it back down to rubble.

name: Move Earth
blurb: The ground heaves up into a hill 35 ft across, highest in the middle. Water runs off it and pools around the foot.
